name: The Denver Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Denver Post's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and Ad Fontes rates it Middle (-2.86). Neither rates the editorial board separately.

name: The Gazette editorial board (Colorado Springs Gazette and Denver Gazette)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Denver Gazette's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and does not rate the editorial board, which writes for both the Denver and Colorado Springs Gazettes.

name: The Colorado Sun
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Colorado Sun Lean Left (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). The nonprofit newsroom has no editorial board and does not endorse.

name: League of Women Voters of Colorado
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that describes the League as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots organization' (https://lwvcolorado.org/) and never endorses candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its candidates page lists its nominees, and its State Central Committee voted positions on the 2026 statewide measures and Issue 7A.

name: Colorado Republican Party (state party)
lean_basis: Official state party organization; its candidates page lists its nominees. As of Oct 17, 2026 we found no state-party positions on the 2026 measures (the site blocks automated reads); see the Weld County GOP entry for a county-party proxy.

name: Weld County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county Republican Party. Adopted positions on all 14 statewide measures by resolution on September 15, 2026. Used here because the state party has published no positions.

name: Bell Policy Center
lean_basis: Self-described progressive group: it takes 'a progressive, research-focused approach to public policy change in Colorado' (https://bellpolicy.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Fiscal Institute
lean_basis: Fiscal policy group that says it is 'committed to advancing people-centered fiscal and economic policies that promote equity and prosperity across Colorado' (https://coloradofiscal.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Independence Institute
lean_basis: Free-market think tank that says it is 'dedicated to advancing policy that protects and advances Freedom' (https://i2i.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Common Sense Institute Colorado
lean_basis: Research group that calls itself 'a leading voice for free enterprise' (https://commonsenseinstituteus.org/about/) and non-partisan. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Statewide chamber of commerce that calls itself 'a unifying voice for business' and works to 'strengthen Colorado’s business climate' (https://cochamber.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation whose stated focus is 'building power for working people and fighting for a fair and just economy for all' (https://coaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Conservation Colorado
lean_basis: Environmental group that says 'We are in the fight to secure a healthy environment' (https://conservationco.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: ACLU of Colorado
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national ACLU Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, checked Oct. 2026). This is its Colorado affiliate.

name: Advance Colorado
lean_basis: Self-described conservative group: it says it works 'to push back on the progressive policies that have put our state on the wrong track' and trains 'emerging conservative leaders' (https://advancecolorado.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Concern
lean_basis: Business group that calls itself 'a statewide alliance of civic and business leaders dedicated to Colorado's future' (https://coloradoconcern.com/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Registered issue committees (official campaign committees for and against each measure)
lean_basis: Not an endorser with a lean. This is the Colorado Secretary of State's official list of the campaign committees registered to support or oppose each measure. Each committee's own lean follows the side it is on.
